items.stem: Which interface is the source-side connector that produces the snapshot?
items.explanation: IFeed<TEntity> is the source connector; its LoadEntities() returns the snapshot of POCOs.

misconceptions.a: ISink is the destination connector — it writes, it doesn't read the source.
misconceptions.c: IEntityCollection<T> is the return type of the feed, not the connector interface.

items.stem: Create, Update, and Delete operations on the destination live on which interface?

options.text: Neither — the engine does them with no connector code

items.explanation: ISink<TEntity> defines the destination operations: New / Create / Get / Update / Delete.

misconceptions.a: The feed only reads the source and returns POCOs; it never writes.

items.stem: In `class StaffFeed : IFeed<Staff>`, what does the method LoadEntities() return?

options.text: Only the Staff records that changed since the last run
A collection of Staff POCOs — the full source snapshot
A count of records written to the destination

items.explanation: LoadEntities() returns the full snapshot as a collection of Staff POCOs; the engine computes the delta from it.

misconceptions.a: The feed returns everything; change detection is the engine's job (L1.4).

items.stem: You need to integrate a brand-new source system. Which connector do you write?
items.explanation: A new source means a new feed that reads that system and returns POCOs. A new destination would mean a new sink.

misconceptions.a: A sink targets a destination; a new source needs a feed.

items.stem: What is the role of an iCacheFeed (ICacheFeed<TEntity>)?

options.text: It caches the source data to make the feed faster
It re-reads the destination's current state so the engine can diff against it; often combined with the sink in one class
It stores the mappings in memory

items.explanation: ICacheFeed lets Synnduit re-read the destination's current state for diffing, and is frequently implemented together with the sink (e.g. SinkAndCacheFeed.cs).

misconceptions.a: Despite the name, it reads the destination state for diffing, not a cache of the source.
